name: ARIA The ORIGINATION ~Aoi Hoshi no Il Cielo~
original_name: ARIA The ORIGINATION ～蒼い惑星のエルシエロ～
source: It is the year 2301. Man has terraformed Mars into a beautiful water planet, and has renamed it "Aqua". Built upon it is Neo-Venezia, an exact replica of old Venice, with beautiful waterways, palaces and plazas. Akari Mizunashi, a 15 year old girl arrives from Man-Home (formerly known as Earth) to become a gondolier trainee at a company called Aria Company. The company is lead by Alicia Florence, one of the three best gondoliers, also known as the three Water Fairies. Trough hard training, Akari aims to become a Prima herself. Many encounters and mysterious events are sure to follow on this planet of miracles.
translation: 時值2301年。人類已將火星改造成美麗的水之行星，並將其更名為「Aqua」。行星上建有新威尼斯，一座完全復刻昔日威尼斯的城市，擁有美麗的水道、宮殿與廣場。15歲少女水無燈里從Man-Home（原名地球）來到這裡，進入亞利亞公司，立志成為見習領航員。公司由艾莉西亞．佛羅倫斯領導，她是三大頂尖領航員「三大水精靈」之一。燈里努力受訓，以成為正式領航員為目標。在這顆奇蹟之星上，無數邂逅與神秘事件正等待著她。
